scope: Synthetic specification review controls adapted from the observed NeoWeaver card projection defect; not a live parser or native consumer
original_parent_requirement: Bounded mutable surface and patch parser, reproducible task and replay

cases.name: parser-claims-replay
cases.review_question: Can this parser Consumer produce the result asserted in then?
cases.counterexample: Parser returns ParsedProposal and emits no Runner event; the parent replay obligation remains unmet.

cards.title: Synthetic parser boundary
evidence_topics: Synthetic fixed source row: bounded parser plus later task replay

semantics.given: Raw single-surface proposal and fixed boundary references are provided.
semantics.when: The parser checks JSON and the fixed mutation boundary.
semantics.then: The patch parses and replays on the fixed TaskSnapshot.
semantics.inputs_outputs: Raw proposal plus fixed inputs → ParsedProposal or DiagnosticRefusal; no replay/effects.
semantics.forbidden: No protected acceptance edits or provider effects.
semantics.negative_case: A stale expected source must refuse.
semantics.unknown_effect: Missing fixed input refuses; unknown earlier write needs original readback.
semantics.replay: Identical parser inputs produce the same parse/refusal, not task execution.
semantics.oracle: Original fixed parser input/result control, not a Runner observation.
semantics.original_owner: Synthetic parser control Producer, no native authority

cases.name: v-copies-result-without-input
cases.review_question: Does this V provide an input that distinguishes a valid candidate from a stale one?
cases.counterexample: Both current and stale candidates can be described as passing; no fixed input/result comparison has been specified.

cards.title: Synthetic parser controls
evidence_topics: Synthetic fixed source row: parser must reject stale source

semantics.subject: Pure parser/refusal only; Runner replay remains a parent obligation.
semantics.oracle: A legal patch parses successfully and rejects stale source.
semantics.positive_control: A legal patch parses successfully and rejects stale source.
semantics.observation_status: NOT_RUN; expected text is not observed behavior.

cases.name: parser-refusal-local-exit
cases.review_question: Do output, then and controls remain at the parser boundary while retaining later replay?
cases.counterexample: A parsed proposal cannot be used as a Runner or Provider receipt; copied parent acceptance is not local exit.

cards.title: Synthetic corrected parser boundary
evidence_topics: Synthetic fixed source row: bounded parser plus later task replay

semantics.given: Current raw single-surface proposal and Owner-fixed allowlist/acceptance/source references are supplied.
semantics.when: The parser checks JSON and compares fixed target/source references.
semantics.then: Return ParsedProposal or DiagnosticRefusal without replay/training/provider effects.
semantics.inputs_outputs: Raw proposal plus fixed inputs → ParsedProposal or DiagnosticRefusal; later Runner remains outside this atom.
semantics.forbidden: No protected acceptance edits or provider effects.
semantics.negative_case: Keep the allowed proposal fixed and change only expected source: DiagnosticRefusal, no replay/write.
semantics.unknown_effect: Missing fixed input refuses; unknown earlier write needs original readback.
semantics.replay: Identical parser inputs reproduce parse/refusal only; TaskSnapshot replay remains a parent requirement.
semantics.oracle: Original control compares output variant, refused condition and unchanged fixed references.

cards.title: Synthetic corrected parser controls
evidence_topics: Synthetic fixed source row: parser must reject stale source

semantics.subject: Pure parser/refusal only; Runner replay remains a parent obligation.
semantics.oracle: Original fixed input/result comparison checks output variant, named refusal and preserved references.
semantics.positive_control: Current allowed single-surface raw proposal plus fixed inputs returns ParsedProposal with no replay/write.
semantics.negative_control: Change only expected source to stale: DiagnosticRefusal naming staleness, no replay/write; missing input also refuses.
semantics.observation_status: NOT_RUN; expected text is not observed behavior.

proof_boundary: Expected review values are source-review criteria, not CLI or native observation results. All three proposals are structurally valid; the original CLI must not claim semantic PASS.
